## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. For UI changes, include a screenshot or recording
from an owned demo/test session. For HTTP/WS changes, include contract-test coverage.

## Regression and release impact

- Affected boundary: chat/native agent, mobile, retained state/PWA, updater, or other.
- Reproduction and regression assertion (include prior failure when fixing a bug).
- Tested commit and harness receipt/log location; distinguish fixtures from native checks.
- Remaining physical-device/agent checks. Leave unperformed observations pending.
- For release metadata/evidence: candidate tag/SHA and docs/releases evidence path.
